text:
Matt H: CI turned red on main after merge of #3523, pre-commit failing on the pipeline. anyone able to triage?
Dev CI Bot: build 4682 — merge to main detected, running checks. pre-commit hook failed (exit code 1). logs: https://ci.internal/r/4682
Jin K: grabbing logs now, will try to repro locally. which tests failed besides the hook?
Matt H: pre-commit failure + a mypy typing error surfaced in the checks. snippet from build log: ```
pre-commit run --all-files...........................................Failed
- rustfmt....................................................................Failed
- mypy.....................................................................Failed
plugins/kv_cache/cache.py:42: error: Incompatible return value type (got "None", expected "CacheEntry")
ERROR: pre-commit hooks failed
```
Sara L: I touched kv_cache in my last PR but only formatting — did not change return types. might be a mypy strictness bump from the recent stub update.
Carla P: can someone run `pre-commit run --show-diff-on-failure --all-files` locally and paste the rustfmt diff? quick bisect might help if it's a config change.
Jin K: running pre-commit in a docker env to match CI (`docker run --rm -v $PWD:/repo precommit:stable pre-commit run --all-files`). will post output in a minute.
Jin K: rustfmt diff looks like a line-wrapping change for kv_cache/mod.rs, but the mypy error is real. snippet: ```
plugins/kv_cache/cache.py:41
-    def get(self, key: str) -> CacheEntry | None:
-        if key not in self._m:
-            return None
+    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[CacheEntry]:
+        ...
```
Matt H: hmm we changed from union syntax back to Optional in a previous commit? maybe a pyright/mypy version mismatch. CI runs mypy 0.991, local is 0.971.
Sara L: confirmed — I accidentally upgraded typed-extensions in my branch which tightened return inference. reverting that dependency change fixed local mypy.
Carla P: easiest short-term fix: add an explicit Optional[CacheEntry] annotation and a small test to pin behavior, then we can follow up to reconcile typed-extensions/mypy versions. I can open a quick PR.
Matt H: please do, and include `pre-commit run --all-files` passing in the PR description. tag me for review.
Carla P: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/3578 — includes annotation fix + rustfmt reformat. pre-commit green locally. PTAL @Matt H @Jin K
Matt H: looking now. if green I'll ask CI to rerun.
Dev CI Bot: requested rerun for build 4682 (triggered by PR 3578). queue 3 -> running.
Jin K: quick note — add `# type: ignore[return-value]` is avoidable here, prefer explicit Optional typing.
Matt H: agreed. merging once CI passes. thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Dev CI Bot: rerun finished — all checks passed. build 4682 -> success.
Matt H: merging to main. thanks team, closing thread. :rocket:
